newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy metalworkers talks to continue Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Italy metalworkers talks to continue Wednesday.

text.p: More talks between unions and employers in Italy's engineering and metalworking industry to try to end their pay dispute will be held on Wednesday, employers' group Federmeccanica said on Tuesday.
The group's director general Michele Figurati made the announcement after meeting leaders of the sector's three unions -- FIOM, FIM and UILM -- for more than two hours at the Labour Ministry.
He said Labour Minister Tiziano Treu was planning to speak to reporters.
Tuesday's talks were the second straight day of efforts to try to end a months-long stand-off.
Talks resumed on Monday for the first time in more than a month. The dispute has already seen three one-day strikes since it began last June which the sector's two-year contract agreement expired.
